description: Retrieve TBA leaderboard insights for a season, or all-time with year 0. Each leaderboard (e.g., most matches played, most blue banners, highest median score) ranks team, event, or match keys by a value. Returns name, year, key type, and ranked value/keys pairs. Large (about 200 KB for a recent season). For the newer typed insights see get_insights_by_category with category leaderboard.

anyOf.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

year.description: FRC season year the insights cover (1992 through next calendar year), or 0 for all-time insights across every season.

name: get_insights_leaderboards
title: Get Season Leaderboards
